fichas.title: British Standards for building materials, elements, and services
fichas.summary: Reference list of British Standards covering textile, resilient, and ceramic floor coverings; cement, lime, masonry, concrete, and insulation materials; steel structures, suspended ceilings, rendering, and plastering; and building services including room heaters, gas appliances, and heating-load calculation. The listed standards include BS ISO 2424, BS EN 14041, BS EN 14411, BS 5385-3, BS 5385-5, BS EN 13055-1, DIN EN 197, BS EN 459, BS EN 413, BS EN ISO 15630, BS EN 206, BS EN 1168, BS 6073, BS EN 771-3, BS EN 1520, BS EN 771-4, BS EN 12602, ASTM C1436, ISO 4898, BS EN 13164 (with a printed parenthetical reference to 13165), BS EN 13914, BS EN 14246, BS EN 13964, BS EN 1993, BS EN 1090, BS EN 60335-2-30, BS 5871, and BS EN 12831.
uses: Reference British standards relevant to building materials, construction elements, and building services

fichas.title: German Standards for building materials, elements, and services
fichas.summary: Reference list of German Standards covering suspended ceilings and steel structures, including structural steel design and construction and trapezoidal steel sheeting. Building-services references cover heating appliances, heating-load calculation, water-based heating-system design, floor-heating systems and components, warm-water underfloor heating, and plastic piping for floor-heating and radiator connections. The listed standards are DIN EN 13964, DIN 18800, DIN 18801, DIN 18807, DIN 4703, DIN EN 12831, DIN EN 12828, DIN EN 1264, DIN 4725, and DIN 4724.
uses: Reference German standards relevant to building materials, construction elements, and building services
